Mia Chen: Quick thread — iterating on dark theme tokens. Ran into some weirdness with the chart accent colors on 14\" MacBook Pro (native OLED simulator).
Samir Patel: photos — what's the specific issue? too low contrast or hue clash?
Mia Chen: Both. The teal is great on panels but disappears in tiny sparkline lines; orange looks neon-y and draws attention away from the selected series. Also code blocks feel 'hot' compared to surface.
Eli Rodríguez: Are we still using the current palette from the figma file? link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/dark-theme-v3
Mia Chen: Yes but proposing small shifts. Idea: compress saturation for small stroke widths, keep saturation for legends and selected states.
Jasmin (a11y): Important: WCAG for non-text graphics is 3:1 for contrast with adjacent colors (per spec for UI components). For charts, we need to treat tiny lines as low-visibility elements. If they need to be distinguishable, increase luminance delta or add a faint halo.
Samir Patel: Agreed. Proposed token changes — rough draft below, thoughts?
Samir Patel: ```
--bg-900: #071018; /* primary background */
--surface-800: #0d161c; /* panels */
--text-100: #e6eef3; /* primary copy */
--muted-60: rgba(230,238,243,0.6); /* subtle labels */
--accent-teal: #4ac6b8; /* used for selected series */
--accent-teal-low: rgba(74,198,184,0.22); /* sparklines */
--accent-amber: #ffb86b; /* warnings / highlight */
--accent-amber-low: rgba(255,184,107,0.18);
--success-green: #4dd17a;
--danger-red: #ff6b6b;
```
Mia Chen: I like the low-alpha versions for sparklines. Could we instead desaturate + bump luminance a bit rather than pure alpha? alpha on dark sometimes looks washed vs on light.
Samir Patel: Good call — alpha blends depend on background. For export/SVG we should support an explicit low-sat variant: `--accent-teal-muted: #63cdbf` (less saturated, slightly lighter).
Jasmin (a11y): Also: avoid green/red as only indicator. Make sure patterns or shape markers exist for colorblind users. Samir, can you run palette through a11y sim and share pass/fail?
Samir Patel: Will run sim tomorrow and post screenshots. Thought: chart hover state should increase stroke-width + glow to make it accessible without changing palette.
Eli Rodríguez: Copy tweak: in the theme switcher, instead of "Dark (recommended)", change to "Dark — production contrast". Small UX copy but helps PM/customer-facing docs.
Mia Chen: +1 on copy. Also adding a small "why" tooltip that links to accessibility guidance.
ThemeBot: Reminder: design token change detected — please update tokens.json and run theme-visual-regression.
Mia Chen: Plan: Samir will iterate tokens and run sim, Jasmin will confirm WCAG deltas, Eli updates the copystring, I'll patch figma with variants and a short note on chart usage. If all green, roll to dev branch canary.
Samir Patel: Sounds good — I'll post results in this thread (will include before/after screenshots and the sim outputs).
Jasmin (a11y): Ping me for the colorblindness layer test and I'll validate with real-world dashboards (tiny lines + legends).
Eli Rodríguez: One more nit — axis ticks: increase the alpha from 0.38 to 0.5 for better readability at small sizes.
Mia Chen: Noted. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: will follow up by 1802349000 with sims and updated tokens.
Mia Chen: closing loop when we have screenshots.
